cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; the Camama government cloud (AGO-006) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the President and INFOSI describe the national cloud and government data centre as keeping public systems under national control (AGO-002, AGO-004, 2026), so stage 2. The Camama government cloud hosts public institutions' data (AGO-006), but no rule on state data is in force, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4.
